Author: MathDad
Name: TarotGen
Punchline: Draw and view TarotGen.io tarot readings in-game.
Description: Draw a tarot reading from TarotGen.io without leaving the game: pick a public spread or do a free draw, see the cards and their meanings, and open any reading by its share code. Drawing without an account needs a draw key, which the plugin gets once through a quick check in your browser. Linking a TarotGen account is optional: it lets you lock readings, sort the pickers by your favorites, and list your readings. Talks only to tarotgen.io over HTTPS.
